(intransitive) To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wonderful.gloss: Surprisingly excellent; very good or admirable, extremely impressive.

wone.gloss: (obsolete, or, archaic, dialectal) To live, reside, stay.

wonk.gloss: (derogatory, informal) An overly studious person, particularly a student.

wont.gloss: (archaic, or, humorous) One's habitual way of doing things; custom, habit, practice.

woo.gloss: (transitive) To endeavor to gain someone's affection/support.

wood.gloss: (uncountable) The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

wood ear.gloss: An edible fungus in the genus Auricularia, shaped like an ear and growing on wood.

wood sandpiper.gloss: A Eurasian species of small wader birds, Tringa glareola, that is the smallest of the shanks.

woodcut.gloss: (uncountable) A method of printmaking from such a block.

wooden.gloss: (figuratively) As if made of wood; moving awkwardly, or speaking with dull lack of emotion.

woodland.gloss: Of a creature or object: growing, living, or existing in a woodland.

woodlouse.gloss: Any of the terrestrial isopod crustaceans of suborder Oniscidea, which have a rigid, segmented exoskeleton, often being capable of rolling into a ball, and feed only on dead plant matter, usually living in damp, dark places, such as under s

woodpecker.gloss: Any bird of species-rich family Picidae, with a strong pointed beak suitable for pecking holes in wood.

woodshed.gloss: An enclosed, roofed structure, often an outbuilding, used primarily to store firewood.

woodwind.gloss: (musical instruments) Any (typically wooden) musical instrument that produces sound by the player blowing into it, through a reed, or across an opening. Woodwind instruments include the recorder, flute, piccolo, clarinet, oboe, cor anglais

woodwork.gloss: (football, rugby) The frame of the goal, i.e. the goalpost or crossbar.

woof.gloss: The sound a dog makes when barking; a bark.
Of a person or thing: to make a sound resembling a dog's bark.

wool.gloss: The hair of the sheep, llama and some other ruminants.

woolly mammoth.gloss: A very hairy mammoth, Mammuthus primigenius, widespread in colder regions of the Northern Hemisphere during the Pleistocene period.

woop woop.gloss: (Australia, informal) An extremely remote area, the middle of nowhere.

wop.gloss: (UK, US, Australia, slang, offensive, derogatory, ethnic slur) A person of Italian descent.

worcestershire sauce.gloss: An English condiment made with vinegar, onions, garlic, etc.; a thin piquant sauce used as a table sauce, to flavour casseroles etc. and as an ingredient in Bloody Marys.

word.gloss: The creative word of God; Logos.
(semantics) The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)
A promise; an oath or guarantee. [from 10th c.]

word processing.gloss: (computing) The creation, input, editing and formatting of documents and other text using software on a computer.

word processor.gloss: A device similar to a simple computer, designed for word processing.

words.gloss: (meiosis) Angry debate or conversation; argument. [from 15th c.]
The lines in a script for a performance.

wordsmith.gloss: One who uses words skilfully. [from late 19th c.]

work.gloss: (intransitive) To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

work out.gloss: (transitive) To develop or devise in detail; to elaborate.

work-to-rule.gloss: A labor protest in which employees do only the minimum work required by the rules of a workplace, following safety or other regulations to the letter in order to cause a slowdown.

workaholic.gloss: In the nature or manner of a workaholic.

workaround.gloss: A means of overcoming some obstacle, especially an obstacle consisting of constraints, or laws or regulations.

workbench.gloss: A sturdy bench or table at which manual work is done by a carpenter, machinist, etc.

worker.gloss: One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

workforce.gloss: All the workers employed by a specific organization or state, or on a specific project.

working class.gloss: The social class of those who perform physical work for a living, as opposed to the professional or middle class, the upper class, or others.

working time.gloss: (legal) The period of time that an individual spends at paid occupational labor. Most countries regulate the working time by law, e.g. by stipulating a maximum number of working hours per week. Exact definition varies by the legislation.

workman.gloss: A man who labours for wages.

workmanship.gloss: The quality of something made by an artisan or craftsman.

workout.gloss: An exercise session; a period of physical exercise.

works.gloss: A mechanism or machinery; the means by which something happens.

workshop.gloss: A room, especially one which is not particularly large, used for manufacturing or other light industrial work.
A brief, intensive course of education for a small group, emphasizing interaction and practical problem solving.

worktop.gloss: (UK) A surface, usually resting on cupboards or drawers that can be used to work on. Usually in a kitchen.

workup.gloss: (countable, medicine) A general medical examination to assess a person's health and fitness.

world.gloss: (with "the" or a plural possessive pronoun) The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

world bank.gloss: A group of five financial organizations whose purpose is economic development and the elimination of poverty.

world exposition.gloss: Any of various large international expositions held since the mid 19th century, often called "Expo".

world health organization.gloss: An agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health

world map.gloss: A map of a world; a cartographic representation, a projection done to scale, representative of a planet's surface.

world order.gloss: A particular structure that manages the world's stability, informed by a number of legal, political and socio-economic factors.

world peace.gloss: The ideology of universal global understanding and non-violence.

world power.gloss: A nation or state so powerful that it can influence world affairs.

world record.gloss: (sports) The world's best score or time for a certain event.

world trade organization.gloss: An international organization designed by its founders to supervise and liberalize international trade.

world war.gloss: A war involving the major nations of the world.

world war i.gloss: (history) The war from 1914 to 1918 between the Entente Powers of the British Empire, Russian Empire, France, Italy, the United States and other allied nations, against the Central Powers represented by the German Empire, Austria-Hungary, t

world war ii.gloss: (history) The war from 1939 to 1945 of the Allied forces, including the United Kingdom, the Soviet Union, the United States, France, and China, against the Axis Powers, including Germany, Italy, and Japan.

world wide web.gloss: (Internet) Usually preceded by the: all of the hypertext documents (web pages) on the Internet collectively, which are (1) stored in various inter-hyperlinked computers around the world, and (2) retrieved typically by means of the Hypertext

worldly.gloss: Sophisticated, especially because of surfeit; versed in the ways of the world.

worldview.gloss: A person's personal view of the world and how one interprets it; any ingroup's or society's mainstream view thereof.

worm.gloss: (archaic, or, poetic) Any creeping or crawling animal, such as a snake, snail, or caterpillar.

wormhole.gloss: A hole burrowed by a worm.

wormwood.gloss: An intensely bitter herb (Artemisia absinthium and similar plants in genus Artemisia) used in medicine, in the production of absinthe and vermouth, and as a tonic.
(figurative) Something that causes bitterness or affliction; a cause of mortification or vexation.

worn-out.gloss: Of a person or animal: exhausted or fatigued from exertion.

worried.gloss: Thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen; feeling afraid and unhappy.

worship.gloss: The devotion accorded to a deity or to a sacred object.
(transitive) To honour with extravagant love and extreme submission, as a lover; to adore; to idolize.

worshipper.gloss: A person who worships, especially at a place of assembly for religious services.

worst.gloss: Most inferior; doing the least good.

worth.gloss: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

worthless.gloss: Having no worth or use; without value.

would.gloss: Used as the auxiliary of the simple conditional modality, indicating a state or action that is conditional on another. [from 9th c.]
Used interrogatively to express a polite request; are (you) willing to …? [from 15th c.]

would like.gloss: Used to politely express a want or desire [with infinitive].

wound.gloss: An injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body.
(transitive) To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wow.gloss: (video games) Initialism of w:World of Warcraft.
An expression of amazement, awe, or admiration.

wraith.gloss: A ghost or specter, especially a person's likeness seen just after their death.

wrangle.gloss: (also, figuratively) To quarrel angrily and noisily; to bicker.

wrap.gloss: Paper or sheeting that is wrapped around something to protect, contain, or conceal it.
(chiefly, in plural, now, rare) An outer garment worn as protection while riding, travelling etc.
A type of food consisting of various ingredients wrapped in a tortilla or pancake.
(transitive) To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.
(transitive) To enclose or coil around an object or organism, as a form of grasping.

wrap one's head around.gloss: (informal, figuratively) To come to a good understanding of.

wrap up.gloss: (transitive, and, intransitive) To cover or enclose (something) by folding and securing a covering entirely around it.

wrapper.gloss: Something that is wrapped around something else as a cover or protection: a wrapping.

wrapping paper.gloss: Paper used for wrapping parcels (in this case, often brown) or presents (in this case, often colourful/colorful and decorative).

wrath.gloss: (uncountable, formal) Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

wreak.gloss: (transitive) To cause harm; to afflict; to inflict; to harm or injure; to let out harm.

wreath.gloss: An ornamental circular band made, for example, of plaited flowers and leaves, and used as decoration; a garland or chaplet, especially one given to a victor.

wreck.gloss: Something or someone that has been ruined.
The remains of something that has been severely damaged or worn down.
(transitive) To destroy violently; to cause severe damage to something, to a point where it no longer works, or is useless.

wreckage.gloss: Something wrecked, especially the remains or debris of something which has been severely damaged or destroyed.

wren.gloss: Troglodytes troglodytes (Eurasian wren, type species and sole Old World species of the family Troglodytidae).

wrench.gloss: (US, Canada, Philippines) A hand tool for making rotational adjustments, such as fitting nuts and bolts, or fitting pipes. [from 18th c.]

wrestle.gloss: To grapple or otherwise contend with an opponent in order to throw or force them to the ground, chiefly as a sport or in unarmed combat.

wrinkle.gloss: A small furrow, ridge or crease in an otherwise smooth surface.
A fault, imperfection or bug especially in a new system or product; typically, they will need to be ironed out.
(transitive) To make wrinkles in; to cause to have wrinkles.

wrist.gloss: (anatomy) The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

wristband.gloss: A band that supports a wristwatch.

wristwatch.gloss: A watch that is worn on a strap or band fastened around the wrist

writ.gloss: (countable, legal) A written order, issued by a court, ordering someone to do (or stop doing) something.

write.gloss: (transitive) To be the author of (a book, article, poem, etc.).
(transitive) To show (information, etc) in written form.

write down.gloss: (transitive) To produce or set (something) down in writing; to record something.

write-up.gloss: A written account of something, as a record.

writer.gloss: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writhe.gloss: (intransitive) To twist bodily; to contort one's self; to be distorted.

writing.gloss: (uncountable) The process of representing a language with symbols or letters.

writing board.gloss: A smooth vertical surface to be written upon using an erasable material, large enough for several persons to read simultaneously.

writing desk.gloss: A desk at which someone may write.

wrocław.gloss: A city in Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Silesia, in what is now southwestern Poland. (At different points in history, the city has been part of Bohemia, Prussia, Germany, and Poland.)

wrong.gloss: (informal) In a way that isn't right; incorrectly, wrongly.
Something that is immoral or not good.

wrong number.gloss: (by extension) A telephone call received from an unfamiliar caller, due to a mistake in the number dialled.

wrongdoer.gloss: Someone who does wrong, whether morally, ethically, or in contravention of a law.

wryneck.gloss: Either of two small woodpeckers, Jynx torquilla and Jynx ruficollis, of the Old World, that turn their heads almost 180 degrees when foraging.

wu.gloss: A river in Guizhou, China, a tributary of the Yangtze.
A river in Hunan, China, a tributary of the Yuan.
(historic) The kingdom ruled by the Ji family from Wuxi and then Suzhou during the Spring and Autumn period of China's Zhou dynasty.

wudu.gloss: (Islam) A ritual washing of the forearms, head, and feet, required after minor impurity, frequently performed immediately before prayer.

wuhan.gloss: A subprovincial city, the provincial capital of Hubei, China.

wuss.gloss: (slang, mildly, derogatory) A weak, ineffectual, cowardly, or timid person.

wyandot.gloss: A member of a Native American people, formed from the Huron confederacy, that lived in and around Ohio.
